purpose: Fail production builds when core demographic model arrays are incomplete, duplicated or numerically invalid.
requiredChecks: 2025 base population has exactly one row for every municipality x sex x age 0-100
fertility profiles cover every municipality x window x age 15-49
mortality profiles cover every municipality x window x sex x age 0-100
net-migration profiles cover every municipality x window x sex x age 0-100
core profile keys contain no duplicates
population, fertility and mortality values are finite and nonnegative
FA membership is exactly the five configured municipalities
governance: This is a structural production gate, not a forecast-accuracy claim.
Any annual SCB refresh must pass the same integrity checks before publication.
Missing cells must fail the build rather than be silently imputed in this layer.
